children.heading: G1 : Effective Tracking of FYP progress
FYP-G1-01
children.text: The system shall provide the FYP coordinator with the ability to view student progress, including milestone completion and submission status for all registered FYP students

children.heading: FYP-G1-02
children.text: The system shall provide supervisors with the ability to view student progress, including milestone completion and submission status of their assigned students.

children.heading: FYP-G1-03
children.text: The system shall provide students with the ability to view their own progress status.

children.heading: FYP-G1-04
children.text: The system shall provide the supervisor with the ability to record each supervision session, including the meeting date and a summary of the discussion.

children.heading: FYP-G1-05
children.text: The system shall provide students with the ability to view their supervision meeting records and progress, including meeting date and summary of discussion

children.heading: FYP-G1-06
children.text: The system shall calculate student progress based on completed milestones and submitted deliverables.

children.heading: FYP-G1-07
children.text: The system shall provide students with the ability to schedule a meeting with their supervisor.

children.heading: FYP-G1-08
children.text: The system shall provide a direct messaging feature to enable communication between students and supervisors.

children.heading: FYP-G1-09
children.text: The system shall allow announcements to be forwarded into the direct messaging system for targeted user communication.

children.heading: G2 : Enable automated submission of FYP deliverables

attributesChanged.heading: G2: Enable automated submission of FYP deliverables

children.heading: FYP-G2-01
children.text: The system shall provide students with the ability to submit FYP deliverables online.

children.heading: FYP-G2-02
children.text: The system shall automatically record the submission date and time for each FYP deliverable.

children.heading: FYP-G2-03
children.text: The system shall update the student progress status upon submission of each FYP deliverable.
children.source: Interview with FYP Coordinator + Prototype Validation

children.heading: FYP-G2-04
children.text: The system shall provide supervisors with the ability to view submitted FYP deliverables of their assigned students.

children.heading: FYP-G2-05
children.text: The system shall notify supervisors when a student submits a FYP deliverable.

children.heading: G3 : Manage supervisor assignment for FYP students
FYP-G3-01
children.text: The system shall provide the FYP coordinator with the ability to assign a supervisor to each student.

children.heading: FYP-G3-02
children.text: The system shall allow students to select their preferred supervisor.

children.heading: FYP-G3-03
children.text: The system shall enable the FYP coordinator to approve or reject students’ supervisor preferences.

children.heading: FYP-G3-04
children.text: The system shall provide the FYP coordinator with the ability to define the maximum number of students that can be assigned to each supervisor.

children.heading: FYP-G3-05
children.text: The system shall provide the FYP coordinator with the ability to define the maximum number of students that can be assigned to each supervisor.

children.heading: FYP-G3-06
children.text: The system shall provide students with the ability to view their assigned supervisor.

children.heading: FYP-G3-07
children.text: The system shall prevent assignment of students to a supervisor if the maximum supervision limit has been reached.
children.source: Faculty Workload Policy (Document) + Interview with Coordinator

children.heading: FYP-G4-01
children.text: The system shall allow students to register for participation in the FYP showcase.

children.heading: FYP-G4-02
children.text: The system shall record the participation details of registered students.

children.heading: FYP-G4-03
children.text: The system shall provide the FYP coordinator with the ability to define available presentation slots, including date, time, and venue.

children.heading: FYP-G4-04
children.text: The system shall provide students with the ability to view their assigned presentation schedule.

children.heading: FYP-G4-05
children.text: The system shall provide the FYP coordinator with the ability to assign evaluators to presentation sessions.

children.heading: FYP-G4-06
children.text: The system shall allow students to select a presentation slot from the available slots.
children.source: Interview with FYP Coordinator + Prototype Validation

children.heading: FYP-G4-07
children.text: The system shall prevent students from selecting slots that are unavailable or fully booked.

children.heading: FYP-G4-08
children.text: The system shall restrict slot selection to a specified booking period defined by the FYP coordinator.

children.heading: FYP-G4-09
children.text: The system shall provide the FYP coordinator with the ability to create and manage announcements.

children.heading: FYP-G4-10
children.text: The system shall provide users with the ability to view announcements.

children.heading: FYP-NFR-01
children.text: The system shall provide role-based access control so that students are prevented from viewing or modifying other students’ grades.

children.heading: FYP-NFR-02
children.text: The system shall ensure that the progress dashboard is responsive so that it is readable on both mobile and desktop browsers.

children.heading: FYP-NFR-03
children.text: When multiple students upload deliverables simultaneously, the system shall process all files without data loss.

children.heading: FYP-NFR-04
children.text: The system shall allow only the coordinator to modify supervisor assignments to maintain data integrity.

children.heading: FYP-NFR-05
children.text: The system shall generate the showcase announcement within 2 seconds of the administrator by clicking the publish button.

children.heading: FYP-NFR-06
children.text: The system shall be available at least 99% of the time during the final week of submission.

children.heading: FYP-NFR-07
children.text: The system shall provide a confirmation message after a meeting record is successfully saved.

children.heading: FYP-NFR-08
children.text: The system shall encrypt all uploaded project files to protect intellectual property.
